title: Azure Virtual Desktop Event Hub field schema catalogue
scope: All 22 requested resource/category pairs, keyed by resource type and category.
notes: Repeated category names are separate entries because their resource types differ.
Log Analytics fields and types are preserved; raw Event Hub paths are not asserted.
Standard Log Analytics columns are separated and must not be required in raw Event Hub payloads.
Allow missing, null and additional fields.
Resource diagnostic Management logs are not a replacement for the Azure Activity Log when auditing ARM control-plane changes.
This catalogue is not a strict JSON Schema validator.
